description: pnpm workspaces resolve every package under packages, apps, and modules
steps: Run `pnpm install` at the repo root
Assert the command exits 0
Assert `pnpm -r list` lists packages from packages/*, apps/*, and modules/*

description: Strict TypeScript ESM typecheck passes across all workspaces
steps: Run `pnpm -w tsc --noEmit`
Assert exit code is 0
Assert tsconfig sets `strict: true` and `module`/`moduleResolution` for ESM

description: Lint and format checks pass on the skeleton
steps: Run `pnpm lint`
Run `pnpm format --check`
Assert both exit 0

description: CI workflow runs lint, typecheck, and tests on push
steps: Open the GitHub Actions workflow file
Assert it defines jobs for lint, typecheck, and `vitest run`
Assert the workflow triggers on push

description: Valid product config parses and profile presets set capability defaults
steps: Call `defineProduct` with a valid `b2b-standard` config
Assert it returns a typed object
Assert `capabilities.organizations` is true and `personalAccounts` is false for b2b-standard

description: Invalid config refuses to boot with a path-level Zod error
steps: Load a config missing `branding.colors.primary`
Assert a Zod validation error is thrown naming the `branding.colors.primary` path
Assert the process exits with a non-zero code

description: Explicit capability override wins over the profile preset
steps: Define a `b2b-standard` config with explicit `capabilities.personalAccounts: true`
Resolve capabilities
Assert `personalAccounts` is true

description: b2b-enterprise profile enables enterprise entitlement keys
steps: Call `defineProduct` with `profile: "b2b-enterprise"`
Assert `capabilities.enterpriseEntitlements` resolves to true

description: Error envelope schema enforces the stable machine code enum
steps: Parse `{ error: { code: "NOT_FOUND", message: "x" } }` with the envelope schema
Assert it validates
Assert an unlisted code fails and that all eight documented codes are accepted

description: Pagination schema defaults limit to 25 and caps at 100
steps: Parse `{}` with the pagination request schema and assert `limit` is 25
Parse `{ limit: 500 }` and assert it is rejected or clamped to 100
Assert the response schema requires `items` and `total`

description: Contracts package is consumable by both api and web workspaces
steps: Import a shared schema in an apps/api module and an apps/web module
Run `tsc --noEmit` in each
Assert both typecheck with no errors

description: Migrations apply and are idempotent on re-run
steps: Run `pnpm db:migrate` against a fresh Postgres
Run `pnpm db:migrate` a second time
Assert the second run reports no pending migrations and exits 0
failure_reason: deferred: requires live DB or apps/* (verified in Group C / evaluate phase)

description: Drizzle client connects via DATABASE_URL
steps: Instantiate the platform-db client with a valid `DATABASE_URL`
Execute `select 1`
Assert it returns a single row
failure_reason: deferred: requires live DB or apps/* (verified in Group C / evaluate phase)

description: Core tables follow uuid v7 PK and timestamp conventions
steps: Inspect the generated core schema
Assert primary keys are uuid v7
Assert `created_at` and `updated_at` columns exist on core tables
failure_reason: deferred: requires live DB or apps/* (verified in Group C / evaluate phase)

description: db:generate emits a migration from the Drizzle schema
steps: Run `pnpm db:generate` after a schema change
Assert a new migration file is written to the migrations directory

description: Health returns 200 and ready reflects DB connectivity
steps: GET /api/health
Assert status 200
Stop the DB, GET /api/ready and assert 503; start DB, assert 200

description: Boot fails fast on missing required env
steps: Start the API with DATABASE_URL unset
Assert the process exits non-zero
Assert the log names the missing env var

description: OpenAPI docs served in dev and errors return the envelope
steps: In dev, GET /api/docs and assert the OpenAPI UI loads
Trigger a handler that throws
Assert the response body is `{ error: { code, message } }` with no stack trace

description: SPA history fallback and graceful shutdown
steps: GET a non-API path like /some/app/route
Assert index.html is returned
Send SIGTERM and assert connections drain and the pool closes before exit

description: Job payloads are Zod-validated before enqueue
steps: Define a job with a Zod schema
Enqueue an invalid payload and assert it is rejected
Enqueue a valid payload and assert the handler runs and the job is marked complete

description: Cron-scheduled job fires on schedule
steps: Register a scheduled job with a short cron interval
Wait past one interval
Assert the handler executed at least once
failure_reason: deferred: runtime delivery (live pg-boss cron / Mailpit) — verified in evaluate phase

description: Email send enqueues a job and delivers to Mailpit with branding
steps: Call `email.send` with the verify template in dev
Query the Mailpit API
Assert a message exists whose subject/body contain `branding.productName` and resolved terminology
failure_reason: deferred: runtime delivery (live pg-boss cron / Mailpit) — verified in evaluate phase

description: Platform ships email-delivery, invite-expiry, and org-purge jobs
steps: Enumerate registered jobs
Assert handlers exist for email delivery, invite expiry sweep, and soft-deleted-org purge

description: audit_log is append-only with the full column set
steps: Inspect the audit_log schema
Assert all documented columns exist with correct nullability
Assert the writer API exposes only an append/log method (no update/delete)

description: ctx.audit.log captures actor, target, and request context
steps: Call `ctx.audit.log` from within a request
Assert a row is written with the action, target_type, target_id, actor_user_id
Assert ip and user_agent are captured from the request

description: Auth events are audited with correct action codes
steps: Perform a successful sign-in, a failed sign-in, and a sign-out
Query audit_log
Assert rows exist with the corresponding sign-in-success, sign-in-failure, and sign-out actions

description: Branding colors are emitted as CSS custom properties on root
steps: Boot the web app with a config
Read `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)`
Assert `--color-primary` (and the derived dark token) equal the configured values

description: Changing primary color and product name rebrands with no component edits
steps: Set `colors.primary` to a new hex and change `productName` in config only
Reload the app
Assert the computed primary token and document.title reflect the new values

description: Logo, favicon, font, and radius are sourced from config
steps: Set logo, favicon, fontFamily, and radius in config
Render the shell
Assert the DOM references the configured logo/favicon and the font-family/radius tokens match config

description: Components render token-driven with no literal hex colors
steps: Render each platform-ui component
Grep `packages/platform-ui` component styles for hex color literals
Assert zero matches and that components reference CSS token variables

description: Dialog and dropdown manage focus and keyboard interaction
steps: Open the Dialog, Tab through it and assert focus is trapped
Press Esc and assert it closes and focus returns to the trigger
Repeat keyboard checks for Dropdown

description: Form primitives surface Zod validation errors with labels
steps: Render a form using the form primitives with a Zod resolver
Submit invalid data
Assert an accessible error is shown and associated with its labeled field

description: useTerm resolves singular, plural, and unknown-key fallback
steps: Call `useTerm("organization")` and assert the configured singular
Call with `{ plural: true }` and assert the plural
Call with an unknown key and assert a sensible default is returned

description: Relabeling organization to Clinic propagates across UI with no code edits
steps: Set `terminology.organization` to Clinic/Clinics in config only
Render settings screens and nav
Assert the noun reads "Clinic"/"Clinics" in screens, nav, and an error message

description: Server term() matches client resolution for emails and messages
steps: Call server `term("organization")`
Assert it returns the same resolved value as `useTerm`
Assert an email template rendered server-side uses the resolved noun

description: Module route trees mount under the org-scoped path
steps: Register a module with `webRoutes`
Navigate to `/o/:orgSlug/<module>`
Assert the module screen renders (and `/app/<module>` for personal-only)

description: Sidebar nav honors manifest contributions and navigation config
steps: Configure `navigation.order` and `navigation.hidden`
Render the sidebar
Assert items appear in the configured order and hidden items are absent

description: 404 and upgrade-notice surfaces render for unknown routes and entitlement errors
steps: Navigate to a nonexistent route and assert the 404 surface renders
Return an ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED error from an API call
Assert the upgrade-notice surface renders

description: better-auth is only imported inside platform-identity
steps: Grep the repo for imports of `better-auth` outside `packages/platform-identity`
Assert zero matches

description: Auth methods configured; magic-link gated by capability
steps: Boot with `capabilities.magicLink: false` and assert the magic-link plugin is not registered
Boot with it true and assert the plugin is registered
Assert email/password, Google, and organization plugins are always present

description: Sessions are httpOnly cookies with sliding expiry, no JWT
steps: Sign in and inspect the Set-Cookie header
Assert the session cookie is httpOnly, SameSite=Lax (Secure in prod)
Assert no JWT is returned to the browser and the session is revocable

description: Account linking merges same-verified-email accounts
steps: Create a password account with a verified email
Sign in with Google using the same verified email
Assert both resolve to a single user record

description: Auth routes mounted under /api/auth
steps: GET/POST a known better-auth route under /api/auth/*
Assert it responds (not 404)
Assert only platform-identity registers the auth handler

description: requireUser gates protected routes
steps: Call a requireUser-protected route with no session
Assert 401 with code UNAUTHENTICATED
Call again with a valid session cookie and assert it passes

description: /api/me returns user, orgs, active role, and permissions
steps: Authenticate and GET /api/me
Assert the body includes user, orgs list, active-org role
Assert it includes the resolved permission set

description: Email/password signup requires verification before sign-in
steps: Sign up with email/password
Assert a verification email appears in Mailpit and that password sign-in is blocked until verified
Click the verify link and assert a session is established

description: Password reset sets a new password and invalidates the old
steps: Request a password reset and open the emailed link
Set a new password
Assert sign-in works with the new password and fails with the old one

description: Sign out other sessions revokes them
steps: Sign in from two sessions
Use "sign out other sessions" in Security settings
Assert the other sessionâ€™s subsequent request returns 401

description: Auth endpoints are rate-limited and failed sign-ins audited
steps: Exceed the sign-in attempt threshold
Assert a 429 with code RATE_LIMITED
Assert each failed sign-in wrote an audit row

description: Built-in roles resolve to correct permission sets
steps: Resolve permissions for owner, admin, and member
Assert owner has all, admin lacks org-delete/ownership-transfer, member has read + module defaults
Assert wildcard permissions are expanded at definition time

description: Registry rejects unknown or duplicate permission references
steps: Register a manifest referencing an unknown permission and assert boot fails
Register a manifest with a duplicate permission id
Assert boot fails with a descriptive error

description: requirePermission enforces access on the server
steps: Call a requirePermission route as a member lacking it and assert 403 FORBIDDEN
Grant the permission via role
Assert the same call now passes

description: CI static check fails routes missing a permission or public marker
steps: Add a route with no permission and no `public: true`
Run the static route check
Assert it fails and names the offending route

description: Personal org auto-created on signup in the same transaction
steps: Enable `personalAccounts` and sign up
Assert a personal org (type=personal, owner=user) exists
Assert it exposes no invite/members endpoints

description: Org creation assigns owner and enforces at-least-one-owner
steps: Create an org and assert the creator is owner
Attempt to remove/demote the only owner and assert it is rejected
Transfer ownership and assert the new owner holds owner role

description: Org deletion is owner-only soft-delete with confirmation
steps: As a non-owner, attempt org deletion and assert it is rejected
As owner, delete with correct name confirmation
Assert `deleted_at` is set and the org is retained (not hard-deleted)

description: Invitation lifecycle: send, resend, revoke, accept
steps: Send an invite with an email and role and assert a 7-day single-use token is issued
Resend and revoke and assert token state changes
Accept a valid invite and assert the invitee becomes a member with the assigned role

description: Org switcher shows only with multiple orgs and reflects URL
steps: Sign in as a user with one org and assert no switcher is shown
Add a second org and assert the switcher appears
Switch orgs and assert the URL slug (`/o/:orgSlug`) updates

description: Members screen supports role change, remove, and admin-create
steps: Open the Members screen and change a memberâ€™s role
Remove a member
Admin-create a member and assert a set-password email is sent

description: Invitations list and read-only roles matrix render
steps: Open the Invitations screen and resend then revoke a pending invite
Open Roles & Permissions
Assert a read-only matrix of code-defined roles is shown

description: withOrg opens a transaction and sets app.org_id
steps: Call `withOrg(orgId, cb)`
Inside cb, run `SELECT current_setting('app.org_id', true)`
Assert it equals the passed orgId and that the work runs inside one transaction

description: Membership middleware returns 404 for non-members before handlers
steps: Call `/api/orgs/:orgId/...` as a user who is not a member of :orgId
Assert the response is 404 (not 403)
Assert no handler-side effect occurred

description: No tenant-table access outside withOrg
steps: Run the architecture/grep test scanning for tenant-table access
Assert every tenant query is routed through `withOrg`
Assert the test fails if a direct access is introduced

description: Tenant tables enforce FORCE RLS with the org_id policy
steps: Inspect each tenant table
Assert `org_id uuid not null` exists
Assert an RLS policy on `current_setting(app.org_id)` is present and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is enabled

description: Runtime role is non-owner and cannot bypass RLS
steps: Connect as the runtime DB role
Attempt to disable RLS or alter policy
Assert it is denied because the role is not the table owner

description: RLS blocks cross-tenant reads at the SQL layer
steps: As the runtime role, `SET app.org_id` to org A
Query a tenant table that also holds org B rows
Assert zero org B rows are returned

description: App-layer cross-tenant probe returns 404/403 for every endpoint
steps: Seed org A and org B
Call each org-scoped endpoint with Aâ€™s session against Bâ€™s ids
Assert every response is 404/403 and no B data is returned

description: Direct-SQL RLS proof with app scoping bypassed
steps: Bypass the app scoping layer and query directly as the runtime role
Assert RLS still blocks cross-tenant reads
Assert the test is part of the CI suite

description: Migration idempotency verified in CI
steps: Run `db:migrate` twice against a fresh DB in the test
Assert the second run produces no schema diff and exits 0

description: entitlements.get returns override or declared default
steps: Call `entitlements.get(orgId, key)` with no override and assert the declared default
Set an override
Assert `get` now returns the override value

description: entitlements.require throws typed 403 when unmet
steps: Call `entitlements.require(orgId, key)` where the entitlement is unmet
Assert a typed 403 with code ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED is thrown

description: Overrides persist and are audited
steps: Write an entitlement override
Assert a row exists in `entitlement_override`
Assert an audit row records the change

description: Upgrade notice CTA is a contact link, not a checkout
steps: Trigger an ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED response in the web client
Assert the upgrade notice renders
Assert the CTA is a mailto to email.fromAddress (or branding.supportUrl) and there is no plan picker/checkout

description: CLI sets and reads entitlement overrides
steps: Run `pnpm ops entitlement set <org> <key> <value>`
Run `pnpm ops entitlement get <org> <key>`
Assert the value round-trips and `list` includes it

description: CLI lists and restores soft-deleted orgs
steps: Soft-delete an org, then run `pnpm ops org list`
Run `pnpm ops org restore <id>` within retention
Assert `deleted_at` is cleared

description: CLI mutations are audited as system:cli
steps: Run any mutating ops command
Query audit_log
Assert the new row has actor `system:cli`

description: Audit viewer requires admin permission
steps: Open the Audit Log screen as a non-admin member
Assert it is hidden or the API returns 403
Open as an admin and assert rows load

description: Audit rows paginate and filter by action and actor
steps: Load the Audit Log with more than one page of rows
Apply an action filter and an actor filter
Assert pagination uses `{ items, total }` and filters narrow the list

description: Audit viewer is org-scoped and never leaks other orgs
steps: Seed audit events for org A and org B
View the Audit Log while active in org A
Assert only org A events appear

description: Workspace and task schema match the spec shape
steps: Inspect the reference-workspace Drizzle schema
Assert `workspace` and `task` tables have the specified columns
Assert task.status is open|done and assignee_member_id is a nullable FK to member

description: Manifest declares permissions, role, and entitlement
steps: Load the module manifest
Assert it declares the three workspace permissions and the Workspace Manager role
Assert it declares entitlement `workspace.maxTasks` with default 100

description: Module contracts appear in OpenAPI
steps: Boot the API in dev and fetch the OpenAPI document
Assert the workspace/task request and response schemas are present

description: Workspace and task CRUD enforce declared permissions
steps: Call workspace create/rename/delete and task add/complete/delete/filter under `/api/orgs/:orgId/workspace/...`
Assert each succeeds for a permitted role
Assert a role lacking the permission gets 403

description: Task assignee must be a current org member
steps: Assign a task to a current org member and assert success
Assign to a non-member and assert rejection
Remove a member and assert their assignment is handled per membership rules

description: Task creation beyond maxTasks returns ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED
steps: Create tasks up to `workspace.maxTasks`
Create one more
Assert the response is 403 with code ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED

description: Workspace events audited and tables isolation-covered
steps: Create and delete a workspace
Assert audit rows for created/deleted
Assert both workspace and task tables are included in the isolation suite

description: Task screen supports add, complete, delete, and open/done filter
steps: Open a workspace task screen
Add a task, complete it, uncomplete it, and delete another
Toggle the open/done filter and assert the list updates via the real API

description: Assignee picker lists org members and assigns
steps: Open the assignee picker on a task
Assert current org members are listed
Select one and assert the task shows the assignee

description: Screens use terminology and show the upgrade notice at the limit
steps: Assert module nouns render via `useTerm`
Create tasks up to the limit
Assert the upgrade notice renders when the entitlement limit is hit

description: Export enqueues a job that produces a task CSV
steps: Trigger "Export workspace"
Assert a job is enqueued
Assert the handler produces a CSV containing the workspaceâ€™s tasks

description: CSV export is emailed via the queue to Mailpit
steps: Run the export in dev
Query the Mailpit API
Assert an email with the CSV attachment/body is present

description: Export job payload validated and retried on failure
steps: Enqueue an invalid export payload and assert rejection
Force a handler failure
Assert the job retries per pg-boss config

description: Local stack and production image both boot
steps: Run `docker compose up` then `pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed && pnpm dev`
Assert the app is reachable locally
Build the production image and assert it boots serving /api and the SPA

description: Deleting the reference module leaves the platform green
steps: Delete `modules/reference-workspace` and its registry line
Run `pnpm db:generate` and `pnpm build`
Assert the platform builds, migrates, and passes platform tests

description: FORKING.md present and seed refuses to run in production
steps: Assert `docs/FORKING.md` documents the fork procedure
Run the seed with NODE_ENV=production
Assert it refuses to run
